newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria sees "positive" results of oil test.
newsitem.headline: Algeria sees "positive" results of oil test.

text.p: Algeria said on Saturday results of an initial test at the eastern oil field of El-Kheit Tessekha No 1 (EKT-1) was positive and its output was estimated at 13,640 barrels per day.

The Algerian official APS news agency said quoting the energy ministry: "The test was in the framework of mining prospects at El-Merk perimetre (bloc 208) located in the eastern Erg province. The well has a pressure of 73 bars."
Algerian giant Sonatrach and U.S.-based Anadarko Petroleum Corp carried out the drilling. It is the 7th exploration made by Algeria since January 1996, the ministry added.
